title: 2024 Bowman - Jaron Elkins - 1st Chrome Lava Refractor 261/399 - Dodgers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2024 Bowman baseball trading card featuring Jaron Elkins of the Los Angeles Dodgers. This card is a 1st Chrome Lava Refractor with a limited print run of 399 and is serial numbered 261/399. Manufactured by Bowman, the card is in English and part of the Major League (MLB) set for the 2024 season. It is a sought-after collectible for fans of baseball and trading card enthusiasts.
